# Backup and Recovery Standard

Revision: v01. Effective: 2023-02-02. Owner: Chief Compliance Officer.

## 1. Purpose

This document sets the minimum requirements for backup and recovery. It exists so that every team applies the same
rules the same way, and so that an auditor can check that they do.

## 2. Scope

This document applies to every employee, contractor and system of the company. Where a contract or a law imposes a stricter
requirement, the stricter requirement applies.

## 3. Definitions

- In-scope systems: every system listed in the asset register with this policy as its control set.
- Owner: the role accountable for this document and for approving exceptions to it.
- Confirmed event: an event that the response team has classified, as opposed to a report.
- Working day: Monday to Friday excluding public holidays at the registered office.

## 4. Requirements

- **R1.** This document is reviewed every 6 months and after any incident that invokes it.
- **R2.** Passwords are at least 16 characters long and are checked against a list of known compromised passwords.
- **R3.** Records covered by this policy are retained for 60 days from the date of their creation and then deleted.
- **R4.** Shared accounts are prohibited; every action is attributable to a named individual.
- **R5.** Changes to in-scope systems follow the change process and are reviewed by a second person.
- **R6.** Monitoring alerts are triaged within one business hour during working hours.
- **R7.** Affected parties are notified within 3 days of a confirmed event.
- **R8.** Encryption in transit uses current, non-deprecated protocol versions only.

## 5. Exceptions

Exceptions are granted only where a requirement cannot be met for technical or legal reasons, are
time-limited, and are reviewed at every scheduled review of this document.

## 6. Review and ownership

The owner of this document is the Chief Compliance Officer, who approves exceptions and signs off every revision.
Material changes are communicated to all affected teams before they take effect.
